name: Monaco: self-employed and small businesses

vatRates.note: Monaco applies VAT on the same basis and at the same rates as France

dueNote: VAT is declared monthly or quarterly as in France. ISB, where it applies, is paid in quarterly instalments (February, May, August, November) and a return by 31 March.

presets.label: TVA 20%, no income tax for residents (non-French nationals)
TVA 20% + ISB 25% (commercial activity with 25% or more of turnover outside Monaco)

buckets.name: isb
buckets.label: Impôt sur les bénéfices, 25% of profit (reserve on revenue, so on the high side)

notes: When ISB applies, it applies to the whole profit.
Monaco has no personal income tax for its residents, except French nationals, who are taxed by France under the 1963 convention.
ISB (25%) applies to industrial and commercial activities, including individual businesses, that make 25% or more of their turnover outside Monaco; civil activities are not subject to it.
Self-employed people pay fixed social contributions (CAMTI health, CARTI pension) outside the vault.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
